priorities.summary: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 lets a remote authenticated attacker execute arbitrary code, because a user-supplied value can influence code the product generates. Published 7 November 2026.
IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 lets a remote authenticated attacker perform arbitrary file writes via path traversal. Published 7 November 2026.

A flaw in Keycloak's client management lets an authenticated attacker with client-management permissions bypass security controls and upload a malicious JavaScript policy, leading to remote code execution. Affects Red Hat Build of Keycloak and Red Hat Single Sign-On 7; published 7 November 2026.

model.name: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.2
model.summary: Anthropic's most capable model for technical work, launched 9 November. It tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 64.6, generates outputs up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1, and costs 20% less at $8/$40 per million tokens; the same underlying model ships as Mythos 5.2 for vetted cybersecurity and life-science users.
